title: Introduce RAG telemetry sampler and mini-orchestrator quickstart
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Teams building RAG-based agents need lightweight, reproducible telemetry for production-like experiments. This PR adds a compact 'telemetry-sampler' quickstart and a 'mini-orchestrator' example that demonstrates end-to-end trace correlation across retrieval, model inference, and tool calls without requiring full backend infra. What it contains: 1) examples/telemetry-sampler/ - Node-based telemetry adapter that instruments RAG flows (retriever->planner->model->tool) and emits structured events compatible with Redwood Console and common OTLP collectors; 2) examples/mini-orchestrator/ - minimal orchestrator (Go) that simulates tool invocation latency and deterministic failures so teams can validate retry/backoff, fallback routing, and telemetry coverage; 3) docs/quickstarts/telemetry-sampler.md - step-by-step quickstart for local run, sample prompts, configuration options, and suggested telemetry queries/dashboards; 4) CI smoke workflow and a compact set of unit/e2e tests that run in GitHub Actions; 5) a small ergonomics helper in examples/telemetry-sampler/config.sample.yaml showing sampling ratios, span attributes, and sensitive-field redaction presets. Usage summary: - Clone repo and cd examples/telemetry-sampler - npm install; set REDWOOD_API_KEY and OTEL_COLLECTOR_URL; npm run start-local to run a local dev server that simulates a RAG session and posts traces. - In a separate terminal run examples/mini-orchestrator/bin/mini-orch to start the simulated tools. - Open docs/quickstarts/telemetry-sampler.md for curated queries and recommended dashboard widgets. Design notes: - Sampler is intentionally lightweight: it samples at configurable ratios and enriches spans with retriever hit-rank, cached_kv=true/false, model_variant, and tool_name. - Mini-orchestrator exposes a deterministic failure mode (error_rate/latency_profile) so teams can validate fallback and A/B routing behaviors without modifying production services. - All telemetry emitted follows the Redwood trace/span attribute naming conventions and includes a trace-level 'rag.session_id' tag to correlate events across services. Checklist/changes included: - [x] telemetry adapter implementation (Node) - [x] mini-orchestrator simulator (Go) - [x] quickstart doc and runbook - [x] CI smoke workflow and unit tests - [x] sample config and telemetry dashboard snippets - [x] small example prompt set for regression monitoring

release_notes: Adds a lightweight RAG telemetry quickstart and a mini-orchestrator simulator for validating end-to-end trace correlation and fallback behaviors. Useful for teams onboarding observability for retrieval-augmented agents. Includes sample queries and CI smoke to prevent regressions.
notes_for_maintainers: This quickstart intentionally depends only on OTLP-compatible collectors and does not ship a collector. When backporting to release branches, only cherry-pick docs and examples; CI smoke workflow references GH Actions runner features added in 2025 so validate runner compatibility.
